svg.aria-label: Constructed matrix and calibration experiments. A compares equal-concentration post-extraction spikes. B and D use a true concentration of 8 ng/mL with matched or mismatched suppression. C has three replicates per concentration around the relationship 0.08c+0.01, fitted from noisy responses.
